verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SolidJS is built on TypeScript and offers a TypeScript template. Nothing in the pack shows any AI tooling, first-party or ecosystem, that automatically resolves type errors. A UI framework's ecosystem could plausibly ship such tooling, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors surfaced by the framework's type system
